newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Capital Intelligence keeps Turkbank rating steady.
newsitem.headline: Capital Intelligence keeps Turkbank rating steady.

text.p: Cyprus-based Capital Intelligence has maintained a BB long term and A-3 short term rating for Turk Ticaret Bankasi A.S. (Turkbank), the specialist bank rating agency said on Tuesday.
The Savings and Deposits Insurance Fund of the Turkish central bank announced it had taken over the administration of Turkbank on Friday.
Turkbank, which employs 4,929 people at its 274 branches in Turkey, will continue its operations under the 100 percent guarantee of the central bank fund.
The bank is to be restructured in the coming two years and sold by the Privatisation Administration.

"CI is maintaining its rating for Turkbank at BB long term and A-3 short term given the 100 percent guarantee from the Savings and Deposits Insurance Fund and pending a clearer picture of its involvement and the bank's financial position," Capital Intelligence said in a news release.

Capital Intelligence said it is believed the move was pre-empted by the central bank on the basis of the strong rise in Turkbank's deposit base, believed to be now around TRL200 trillion (TRL84 trillion at end 1995) relative to its paid-in capital of TRL3 trillion.
It said the central bank had authorised Turkbank to raise its paid-in capital to TRL28 trillion but it had been unable to do so given its narrow shareholding base.

Capital Intelligence said it expects an increase in paid in capital will take place over the next four weeks, and that the fund is also expected to assume the burden of remaining bad debts relating to its exposure to the failed Sumerbank.
"It remains an important bank in the Turkish economy and has always been perceived to have a close working relationship with the state apparatus," said Capital Intelligence.
It added that a clearer picture of the bank's position is expected to emerge in the next three to four weeks.
